# Exact unmodified MPL-2.0 component sources

- option-ext 0.2.0: runtime dependency, original crate archive source.
- cbindgen 0.28.0: build-time tool, original crate archive source.

These directories preserve the crates.io source contents and license files;
only Cargo's local .cargo-ok cache marker is omitted. Original .cargo_vcs_info.json
records the upstream commit. No component source was modified for Schnauz.
The same sources are provided as a ZIP alongside each Mac release.
